title: MindShare
tagline: A decentralized platform empowering professionals to monetize their expertise.
description:
MindShare is an innovative, decentralized platform designed to transform how professionals offer their expertise and how clients access these services. It leverages the power of blockchain technology, AI, and secure web protocols to create a seamless, trustworthy, and efficient marketplace for professional services. Here's a detailed overview:

MindShare caters to professionals from various fields – consultants, educators, legal advisors, tech experts, etc. – allowing them to monetize their time and expertise. It's a marketplace where knowledge is the primary commodity, and transactions are executed with transparency and security inherent to blockchain technology.
how_its_made:
Core Components
1) Reputation Verifier
Utilizes zero-knowledge proofs, ensuring professionals can verify their skills and background without compromising sensitive personal data.
The tlsnotary framework acts as a backbone, providing a secure way to attest to a user's off-chain reputation.
This component is crucial for establishing trust in a decentralized environment, encouraging clients to engage with verified experts confidently.

2) Web App & Smart Contracts
The platform features a user-friendly web application where professionals can list their services, set availability, and clients can browse and book these services.
Transactions for these services are handled through smart contracts on a blockchain. This ensures transparency and security, as the terms of service and payments are encoded in these contracts.
Cryptocurrency is used for transactions, broadening accessibility and simplifying cross-border payments.

3) AI-Assisted Zoom App
An integrated Zoom application is enhanced with AI capabilities.
It assists in scheduling meetings, taking into account the availability and preferences of both parties.
During meetings, the AI tool provides real-time transcription services, making it easier to track discussions and maintain records.
Post-meeting, the AI assistant can help in organizing and summarizing key points, enhancing productivity.
